detail.description: Continence Care CareTip™ Catheter The CareTip™ intermittent catheter is designed to minimise urethral trauma. The superior patent protected hydrophilic coating technology* can reduce coefficient of friction to <0.02** or below (Excellent/Low based on industry standards) Male and Female variants available Quick and easy to use straight form the packaging The ready to use hydrophilic coating maintains stable super-lubricity, ensuring a comfortable experience for patients Rounded and smooth eyelet holes provide less resistance and a more comfortable insertion and withdrawal Adhesive sticker and hanging hole to assist with ease of catheterisation wherever you may be The touch-free gripper is hygienic and protects against urinary tract infections *Independently researched and developed patent protected coating technology
features: Quick and easy to use straight form the packaging
The ready to use hydrophilic coating maintains stable super-lubricity, ensuring a comfortable experience for patients
Rounded and smooth eyelet holes provide less resistance and a more comfortable insertion and withdrawal
Adhesive sticker and hanging hole to assist with ease of catheterisation wherever you may be
The touch-free gripper is hygienic and protects against urinary tract infections

detail.description: For a fast and convenient NIBP, BP10 is an indispensable clinical tool with the added benefit of being both small and lightweight. Deep Learning The deep learning methods of the Deep Convolutional Neural Network (DCNN) are able to process enormous amounts of data through a network of decision making nodes, or neurons, and are well regarded for their excellent performance in image recognition-based applications. Deep Learning Reconstruction (DLR) AiCE was trained on vast amounts of high-quality images reconstructed with an advanced MBIR algorithm that is too computationally intensive for clinical use. This training taught AiCE to distinguish true signal from noise. The results were validated by a team of radiologists, medical physicists, AI scientists, and clinical researchers, producing a fast, fully-trained reconstruction algorithm ready for clinical use. The DCNN learns which methods are best applied to maintain the spatial resolution and low-noise properties contained in the advanced MBIR algorithm. The more variations of data supplied during training, the better the final algorithm will perform in terms of image quality and processing speeds. detail.description: The Uccello Kettle is a safe and elegant assistive technology that makes handling boiling water safely seem effortless. It opens up a world of confidence and independence for anyone who wishes to handle boiling water safely. Unlike other kettles and kettle-tippers, the circular shape of the Uccello Kettle, combined with its rotating cradle, moves around the body of water to assist the flow of the pour, so you don t have to lift, strain, balance or aim. The positioning and shape of the ergonomically designed Uccello handle means weight is distributed across the entire arm, not on fingers and wrists, which makes it easier to handle comfortably. While most kettles require that you awkwardly lift and hold open the spout while refilling, the Uccello s one touch to open hinged lid, requires the lightest of touches to tap open or close. Uccello s detachable water body vessel sits comfortably within a sturdy base that has the added safety of non slip feet for further stability of pour. The black and white contrast design of the Kettle, helps individuals with dementia and low visibility differentiate the important parts of the Kettle, including the easy touch lid button. This elegant feature is also a safety feature. From first to last drop of boiling water, the tapered design of the spout ensures water is targeted to the same spot every time, without the splashing, inconsistency or lack of control experienced with ordinary kettle pours. With so much peace of mind including a wide opening for easy filling, quiet boiling and auto shut off protection from overheating Uccello brings you the next level in safe, elegant and effortless assistive technology. 1.5 litre (6 cup) capacity.

detail.description: Real-time visibility into equipment status, inspections and documentation. Supporting safe patient handling and efficient daily operations.
The GH3 ceiling hoist is a stationary lifting module that is user-friendly and powerful enough to handle lifting and moving procedures in almost all professional care settings.

The GH3+ ceiling lift is a faster, sturdier and more powerful version of the standard GH3 lifting module. It is designed for use in almost all professional care settings, and with a lifting capacity of up to 400 kg on a single strap, it is ideal for use in bariatric care.

A GH3+ hoist equipped with the Trainer Module provides you with the possibility to improve patient mobility and physical function with dynamic body weight support. This supports early mobilization and training opportunities.

products.name: Class Iii Scale Module For Gh3Plus

detail.description: The Class III Scale is an approved medical scale integrated into a ceiling hoist, fulfilling the conditions for medical weighing with calibrated, verified and repeated weight measurements with Class III precision.

The GH3 Twin ceiling hoist comprises two GH3 lifting modules and uses two lifting straps. This module is designed for lifting and moving heavy bariatric people, and is also ideal for horizontal lifts in combination with Guldmann Horizontal Lifters.

The GH1 lifting module has been designed to deal with day-to-day lifting needs typically encountered in private homes, sheltered accommodation and nursing homes. It takes up little space, is easy to operate and helps make lifting and moving processes safe, simple and comfortable for user and care staff alike.
The GH1+ ceiling hoist combines the proven reliability of the GH1 with built in online functionality.

The GH1 Q lifting module is a variation of the GH1 model, supplied with a click system that makes it simple to fit the lifting module to the rails and remove it again if it is necessary to move the module to a different room or apartment.
The GH1+ Q ceiling hoist combines the proven performance of the GH1 Q with built in online functionality.

The GH1 F is a versatile lifting module that is simple to move from one room to another using the associated transport and storage trolley. The module automatically fits itself to and removes itself from the rail system, which means that carers avoid lifting, stretching and bearing heavy loads when moving and fitting the ceiling hoist.
The GHZ is a discreet – almost invisible – patient lift that ensures safe and comfortable lifts and an ergonomically safe working environment for care staff.

There are three types of rails – A, B and C. The three different versions have been optimised in relation to bearing capacity and reach, and they can all be installed quickly and easily. The rails can be installed on walls, ceilings and floor-mounted brackets – or using any combination of these. .

Guldmann wall rails are designed for direct installation on all types of wall. A flexible traverse rail can be used with the wall rail system to compensate automatically for irregularities of up to 80 mm.

The Guldmann Combi-lock is used to link two rail systems. Using the combi-lock, you can link two rail systems – between bedroom and bathroom, for example – to ensure an easy, comfortable move for the patient.
Switch track modules are designed for installation in places where it is necessary or desirable to run rails in different directions

A turntable is designed for situations in which it is necessary to run the rail system in several directions. In practice, this electrically operated turntable is installed where two rails intersect, allowing the ceiling hoist to move in multiple directions.
The Positioning lock adds yet another option to the Guldmann GH3 ceiling hoist system for moving, treating, mobilising and rehabilitating people.
The Upright support bracket is ideal for installations where rails cannot be fixed to the wall or ceiling – in rooms with large windows, for example.

products.name: Free Standing Rail System Room Covering Length And Height Adjustable

detail.description: The free-standing rail system is a mobile system that covers the entire room. It is simple to put up, take down and transfer from one location to another.

products.name: Free Standing Rail System Room Covering

detail.description: The free-standing rail system is a mobile system that covers the entire room. It is simple to put up, take down and transfer from one location to another.
The free-standing single rail system is a mobile system that is simple to put up, take down and transfer from one location to another.
Swing Lift is a rail system made of weatherproof and waterproof material. It is designed for use in harbour settings and next to indoor and outdoor swimming pools

The Transfer platform is a manual, mobile working tool that makes it easier to move standing and semi-independent users. The platform can be used in all healthcare environments, ensuring an active and safe standing transfer of the user and a safe and ergonomic working environment for the carer.

Mobile Lifters constitute a floor-based alternative to ceiling-mounted lifting and moving systems. Two versions of the GL5.2 model are available with lifting capacities of 155 and 205 kg, respectively.
The Active lifter is a mobile standing lifter designed to facilitate day-to-day routines for users and carers alike. The GLS5.2 model is designed to lift the user from a seated to a standing position

products.name: Standing Sling For Gls52 Active Lifter

detail.description: The Standing Sling with elastic belt is used in connection with the Guldmann GLS5.2 Active Lifter and is designed to assist the user from a seated to a standing position.
The Guldmann Active Micro Plus sling is ideal for moving users in a sitting position, with the emphasis on access for toileting and other hygiene procedures.

The Guldmann Active Trainer (gait trainer) is a walking sling for people with sufficient leg strength to stand upright, but who have difficulty balancing. The Active Trainer is a sling to help maintain standing and provide support whilst walking.

The Gait Trainer is a walking sling for users who have sufficient leg strength to stand upright, but need support and to feel safe during training due to reduced balance. The Gait Trainer sling provides the needed support during walking and gait training and helps the user maintain standing. The sling is among other things designed for use in conjunction with the Guldmann Trainer Module, which is an optional feature available within the GH3+ hoist.

Grâce à notre expertise chirurgicale, nous avons créé une gamme de trousses d’intervention chirurgicales Pack+ ® . Choisissez une solution Universal Pack+ toujours disponible ou créons ensemble une trousse véritablement sur mesure. Notre gamme de trousses chirurgicales Pack+ est disponible pour le soutien des interventions de routine notamment en orthopédie, obstétrique, gynécologie et ophtalmologie. Choisissez des composants à incorporer à votre trousse chirurgicale, notamment des champs de caméra, des tubes d’aspiration, des bandages et des pansements.

Grâce à notre expertise en radiologie, nous avons créé une gamme de trousses d’intervention spécialisée Pack+ ® . Choisissez une solution Universal Pack+ toujours disponible ou créons ensemble une trousse véritablement sur mesure. Notre gamme de trousses de radiologie Universal est disponible pour le soutien de vos interventions vasculaires ou non vasculaires. Nous offrons également une gamme de trousses personnalisés pour soutenir des interventions plus spécifiques telles que l’hystérosalpingographie ou la biopsie. Choisissez des composants à incorporer à votre trousse de radiologie, notamment des solutions de mise au rebut des déchets, des systèmes d’administration de substances de contraste et des dispositifs de confinement des aiguilles.

Grâce à notre expertise chirurgicale, nous avons créé une gamme de trousses d’intervention cardiaque Pack+®. Choisissez une solution Universal Pack+ toujours disponible ou créons ensemble un kit véritablement sur mesure. Notre gamme de trousses cardiaques est disponible pour le soutien des interventions de routine telles que le pontage aorto-coronarien, la thoracotomie et le remplacement valvulaire. Nous offrons également une gamme de trousses personnalisés que vous pouvez adapter à vos interventions plus spécialisées. Choisissez des composants à incorporer à votre trousse cardiaque, notamment des boucles vasculaires, des sutures et des canules aortiques.

Grâce notre expertise de soutien dans le cadre du domaine spécialisé de la chirurgie laparoscopique, nous avons créé une gamme de trousses d’intervention Pack+ ® . Choisissez une solution Universal Pack+ toujours disponible ou créons ensemble une trousse véritablement sur mesure. Notre gamme de trousses laparoscopiques est disponible pour le soutien des interventions de routine telles que le traitement des hernies, la chirurgie gynécologique et bariatrique. Nous offrons également une gamme de trousses personnalisés que vous pouvez adapter à vos interventions plus spécialisées. Choisissez des composants à incorporer à votre trousse laparoscopique, notamment des trocarts, des instruments laparoscopiques et des poches de récupération de tissus.

Aufbauend auf unserer radiologischen Erfahrung haben wir eine Reihe von speziellen Pack+ ® -Interventionssets entwickelt. Wählen Sie eine stets verfügbare universelle Pack+-Lösung oder stellen Sie gemeinsam mit uns ein individuelles Set für Ihr Fachgebiet zusammen. Unsere Palette an universellen Radiologie-Sets unterstützt Ihre vaskulären oder nicht vaskulären Eingriffe. Wir bieten zudem eine Reihe kundenspezifischer Sets für spezifische Eingriffe wie HSG oder Biopsie an. Für Ihr radiologisches Set stehen zahlreiche Komponenten zur Auswahl, darunter Abfallentsorgungslösungen, Kontrastmittelsysteme und Nadelabwurfgeräte.

detail.description: Brachytherapy for cervical cancer Brachytherapy is an essential component of treatment for cervical cancer, offering real advantages over other cervical cancer treatment options in terms of survival rates and side effects. Depending on the tumor stage, it can be performed with intracavitary or combined intracavitary/interstitial technique. On the basis of high-level evidence from randomized controlled trials, brachytherapy is indicated as standard in combination with chemoradiation in patients with locally advanced cervical cancer (LACC). Brachytherapy can be used alone in some cases of early-stage cervical cancers. Procedure What is the brachytherapy procedure for cervical cancer? Intracavitary brachytherapy is placed into the vagina (open cavity), close to the cervix uteri. Small radioactive sources precisely deliver radiation through an applicator and are completely removed after delivery, so no radioactivity will remain in the patients’ body. Modern brachytherapy uses Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) or Computed Tomography (CT) images to control the position of the tumor and the radioactive source. detail.description: MR-guided radiation therapy (MRgRT) for pancreatic cancer Escalate dose with certainty Reduce margins to deliver ablative doses safely Pancreatic cancer has one of the lowest overall survival rates of any cancer 1 . Currently, the standard of care for inoperable pancreatic cancer involves the use of non-ablative radiation doses, since the high doses required to completely eradicate tumors are deemed unsafe using conventional CT-guidance. Elekta Unity supports the safe delivery of ablative radiation doses to pancreatic targets in just five sessions. MR-guided radiation therapy (MRgRT) enables you to see the tumor and surrounding OARs clearly for more accurate target delineation. With this superior soft tissue visualization and the ability to manage intrafraction motion, Elekta Unity allows the use of smaller margins–reducing dose to healthy tissue and supporting safe dose escalation. The delivery of ablative doses by MRgRT has been shown to provide excellent local control for patients with inoperable pancreatic cancer, offering them a safe and effective treatment alternative. Xoft offers patients a non-invasive alternative to surgery for nonmelanoma (NMSC) treatment. With Elekta Xoft, painless, scar-free treatment of NMSC is possible with skin eBx (electronic brachytherapy), a form of high dose rate, low energy radiation therapy delivered in minutes over a short series of office visits. While surgery is considered to be the standard of care for NMSC, for some patients, surgery is not an option or a preference. Skin eBx is particularly ideal in treating anatomically challenging locations, such as the face, scalp, nose, ears, arms and legs, as well as areas prone to difficulties in wound healing. detail.description: 2023 American College of Veterinary Radiology (ACVR) Treatment Plan Study September 13, 2023 2 minute read ProKnow is proud to support the annual meeting of the American College of Veterinary Radiology (ACVR) by hosting our first ever Veterinary Treatment Plan Study . The technology used for this study will be our ProKnow Systems plan study program . Quick Facts Patient The patient is a 12-year-old neutered male Golden Retriever cross with a diagnosis of a heart base tumor. Prescription 30 Gy in 3 fractions (10 Gy/fraction). Plan Quality Plan quality calculations will be based on 27 scored target and OAR metrics, plus two non-scored plan metrics (beams and MUs). Plan Study Leaders The study is designed and led by a team from the University of Saskatchewan , led by Dr. Monique Mayer, DVM, MS, DACVR (RO). Who Can Participate? Any and all veterinary clinicians who treat with radiation therapy are encouraged to participate. In addition, radiation therapy experts who treat only humans are also invited to submit plans! products.name: The 2023 Aamd Plan Study A Question Of Time

detail.description: The 2023 AAMD Plan Study - A Question of Time May 3, 2023 5 minute read Hi there, everyone! This short message is to announce the 2023 AAMD ProKnow Plan Study , which is, as always, open to anybody and everybody in the international radiation therapy community. The more people who participate, the more we all learn and move forward, so we hope that hundreds of you can carve out a little time in your schedule in the month of May to take part. We are trying a unique strategy for this study — a strategy that introduces some different, but timely, learning objectives that have immediate relevance to our day-to-day craft. Here, we will summarize these objectives and tell you the “next steps” for getting started. A “Timely” Question In conventional plan studies, you are provided a dataset with images and predefined anatomy, then given a challenging plan quality scorecard to use to create and assess your treatment plan. By looking at the population, and in particular, high-performing plans, we can learn which techniques, technologies, and human tacticians can score the highest. Then, we gather those methods and try to share them with you all, along with giving the interactive (and anonymi
features: Phase 1 will look like a conventional, scored plan study. However, there is NO need to spend inordinate time trying to optimize your score here. Rather, just create a practical, high-quality plan that you are happy with, following the basic instructions. The scores of the initial plans will be studied only in terms of their relationship to the ultimate efficiency metric of the adaptive plan and not as a primary focus.
Do this phase of the study whenever it’s convenient for you. You do not need to time yourself or reserve chunks of time in your schedule for this phase!
Start your timer as soon as you import the new images and structures into your planning system.

The scorecard for Phase 2 will have the same metrics as the initial plan (with perhaps a twist or two, emulating an ambitious radiation oncologist), but the objectives will be binary (either “goal met” or “goal not met”).
Your job is this: Using your initial plan as a starting point, you will design plan(s) for the new anatomy until you meet all the binary goals.
Once you have a plan that meets all the goals, stop your timer , then calculate your planning time (in units of hours, e.g., 1.25 hours).
Submit your adaptive plan to ProKnow and answer the survey questions , the most critical one of which is how long it took to create the adaptive plan that met all goals.
What is the variation in planning time it takes to achieve all goals for all metrics for an adaptive plan?
What is the variation in adaptive planning time across different TPS models?
Is there any correlation in adaptive planning time vs. original plan score (i.e., does a higher quality initial plan makes adaptive planning faster)?
Is there a correlation in adaptive planning time vs. user-specified software or hardware “grade?”
Does adaptive planning speed vary with years of treatment planning experience?
For any given TPS, what tips and techniques can speed up the process of designing an adaptive plan?

detail.description: MR-guided online adaptive radiation therapy (MRgRT) for rectal cancer Preserve rectum with daily precision Safely escalate dose for organ preservation Treatment for rectal cancer typically involves a course of radiation therapy in combination with chemotherapy and/or surgery. Conventional, CBCT-based treatments provide limited image resolution at the time of treatment, requiring the use of large safety margins due to target and OAR motion. This also limits dose escalation and the potential for a complete pathological response. There is growing interest in MR-guided radiation therapy (MRgRT) to reduce RT-related toxicity and allow dose escalation approaches. This could increase the likelihood of complete clinical response and reduce the need for surgery. With Elekta Unity you can: Safely escalate dose to the tumor and consider more rectal cancer patients for organ preservation strategies. Clinical benefits Clinical benefits Elekta Unity MR-guided radiation therapy for rectal cancer With superior real-time imaging and daily online plan adaptation, Elekta Unity allows you to safely escalate dose to the tumor and consider more rectal cancer patients for organ preservation strategies. I
features: Improve local control with safe, anatomy-adaptive dose escalation
Use smaller margins to spare healthy tissue and reduce side effects
Preserve rectal function and improve quality of life
Offer an effective alternative to surgery
Assess and adapt to early treatment response

detail.description: Your browser does not support the video tag. MR-guided radiotherapy for prostate cancer Reduce margins. Reduce fractions. Preserve function. Continuous MR imaging reveals just how much the prostate moves and changes shape between and during fractions. This mobility challenges treatment accuracy and precision. While margins account for uncertainties, irradiation of healthy tissue can result in toxicity and associated side effects. Elekta Unity MR guided radiation therapy allows you to see the prostate and surrounding organs clearly as you treat, enabling you to respond to change and motion, and to adapt the plan for each patient and every fraction. With Elekta Unity you can: Reduce margins with certainty. Reduce number of fractions to 5. Preserve quality of life and erectile function. Clinical benefits Clinical benefits Elekta Unity MR-guided radiation therapy for prostate cancer Elekta Unity allows clinicians to treat even the most challenging prostate SBRT cases with low toxicity. products.name: CliniShield® Advance 360° Foam & Spray Skin Cleanser

detail.description: Gently cleanses the skin . The cost-effective CliniShield Advance 360° Foam & Spray Skin Cleanser features innovative 360-degree technology that allows the skin cleanser to be discharged at any angle, including completely upside down. This functionality is a significant advantage for reaching difficult areas or assisting users with limited mobility. The device further enhances care through its dual-application modes: the foam mode provides a dense, localised texture ideal for managing heavy soiling while the spray mode offers a lighter, broader application suited for lighter cleaning and routine hygiene. The product may be used on adults and children.

Protects your skin. Prevents soreness. Preserves skin integrity. Our cost-effective CliniShield Advance Protective Barrier Cream offers protection for intact and injured skin prone to moisture damage. It is indicated for use in incontinence care, protecting skin from exposure to urine, faeces, and other bodily fluids. The protective barrier cream provides long-lasting, waterproof protection for up to 24 hours – perfect for soothing soreness from incontinence or skin folds. Its gentle formula ensures it will not block continence pads, so they stay fully absorbent. The protective barrier cream moisturises and provides a protective barrier restoring the skin’s hydration. The product may be used on adults and children.

Double the security. The Aura 2 Urostomy pouch connects to the Aura 2 Urostomy flange with a coupling system, with the extra benefit of an adhesive ring which provides additional security. With flat and convex flanges available, there’s an option which will ensure your secure and discreet two-piece fit. Our Aura 2 Urostomy flanges are specifically designed for urostomates, offering enhanced durability whilst still being flexible and comfortable. Promoting skin health. The skin-friendly Hyperflex ® hydrocolloid flange contains medical grade Manuka honey which may help promote healthy skin around the stoma. Made from all natural ingredients with no preservatives or tackifiers, Aura 2 provides reliable adhesion which is still kind and gentle for your skin. Our Manuka honey infused products have received dermatological accreditation from the Skin Health Alliance. This means you can be confident and assured that our products meet the highest standards of skin safety. Designed for incorporation into your daily life. With a super soft, water-repellent cover for comfortable wear and a split-back cover for simple application and monitoring of output, Aura 2 is designed to enhance your stoma care routine and to give you peace of mind throughout the day.

Unique range to help reduce skin trauma during adhesive dressing removal. The removal of adhesive medical devices and dressings is not only associated with increased nursing time due to the pain, anxiety and difficulty it can cause, but repeated application and removal can also cause damage and result in medical adhesive related skin injuries (MARSIs) such as skin stripping and can also increase the risk of infection. Appeel Sterile Medical Adhesive Remover is designed for quick and easy removal of medical adhesive devices and dressings, preventing MARSIs, reducing pain and the risk of infection. It can be used on intact and injured skin and is ideal for those with fragile skin such as babies and the elderly, or for blistering conditions like epidermolysis bullosa. Evidence shows that the inert fluid in Appeel Sterile Medical Adhesive Remover is not metabolised by the skin, ensuring that it is safe to use on injured skin and will not impact wound healing¹. All Appeel Sterile products are made of healthcare-grade silicones which are no-sting (alcohol-free) and dry quickly leaving no residue. This allows for adhesive medical devices and dressings to be re-applied shortly after use. 1 CliniMed data on file, 2010

products.name: Appeel® No Sting Medical Adhesive Remover

detail.description: The repeated application and removal of stoma pouches and their accessories can lead to peristomal skin damage and pain. Use of Appeel Advance Medical Adhesive Remover helps to protect skin, whilst reducing the risk of damaging peristomal skin or experiencing pain from repeated stoma bag changes. Appeel Advance is a product within stoma care for assisting in the removal of stoma bags. It is available in individual wipes and a spray that can be used at any angle.

products.name: CliniShield® Advance No Sting Barrier Film Range

detail.description: Protects your skin. Prevents soreness. Prepares skin surface. Skin contact with an adhesive appliance can leave the skin red and sore. The CliniShield Advance Barrier Film range protects your skin for up to 48 hours. By applying CliniShield Advance, you’ll create a waterproof barrier over your skin, keeping it safe from damage. CliniShield Advance creates a smooth, dry surface for the adhesive appliances to adhere to. This can improve the seal and potentially extend wear time by reducing leaks and the need for frequent changes. By creating a barrier and reducing irritation, CliniShield Advance can help maintain a healthy skin environment, which is crucial for healing and preventing further skin breakdown. The CliniShield Advance Range was specially formulated as an affordable option, providing quality care without stretching NHS budgets.

Protecting the skin is a complicated process that is often taken for granted until damage occurs. LBF Sterile Barrier Film provides a protective barrier against the harmful effects of bodily fluids such as wound exudate and excessive perspiration, which can cause maceration and irritation. It also helps to protect against pressure, friction and shear which can lead to the formation of pressure ulcers, as well as adhesive trauma caused by the repeated removal of adhesive medical devices and dressings. LBF Sterile Barrier Film dries rapidly on the skin, forming a breathable, long-lasting transparent barrier which helps to preserve skin integrity. The fluid remains sterile for each application, making it suitable for use on both intact and injured skin.

Protecting the skin is a complicated process that is often taken for granted until damage occurs. LBF Barrier Cream moisturises the skin whilst providing a protective barrier against the harmful effects of bodily fluids such as wound exudate and excessive perspiration, which can cause maceration and irritation. The cream is a skin-friendly formulation suitable for intact skin. The waterproof formulation offers long-lasting protection and will not block incontinence pad absorbency. The cream’s balanced consistency makes it easy to apply and spread across the skin, which maximises coverage and reduces application time. Its highly concentrated formula covers a large area of skin, so a little cream goes a long way. It also helps to protect against pressure, friction and shear which can lead to the formation of pressure ulcers. LBF Barrier Cream is ideal for fragile skin as the barrier helps to prevent adhesive trauma and skin stripping caused by the repeated removal of adhesive medical devices and dressings.

The CliniPeel Medical Adhesive Removers spray (non-fragranced) and wipes contain silicone which effortlessly releases adhesive appliances such as stoma pouches and urinary sheaths from the skin to reduce skin trauma and pain. It’s fast drying, leaving no residue on the skin, which allows adhesive appliances to be re-applied shortly after use. It helps maintain skin integrity whilst assisting quick and easy adhesive appliance removal. Stoma pouch removal with CliniPeel Mint 2-in-1 The CliniPeel Medical Adhesive Remover Mint spray also contains silicone which aids in the quick and easy removal of stoma pouches. For an even fresher feel, try CliniPeel Mint 2-in-1, delicately scented with pure peppermint oil. The added fresh peppermint scent helps mask odours between pouch changes and eliminates the need for an additional deodoriser. Our CliniPeel Range of skin care products are cost-effective without compromising on quality and are able to provide a cost saving to the NHS.

products.name: HyperSeal Mouldable Seals with Manuka Honey

detail.description: HyperSeal Mouldable Seals with Manuka Honey seal the gap between the stoma and the skin around the stoma, providing extra security when the pouch is applied. They are flexible and mouldable, so help to fill in dips and creases around the stoma. Skin friendly Gentle and nurturing, Manuka honey provides additional comfort and is kind to the skin around the stoma. The hydrocolloid is made from all natural ingredients, without any preservatives or tackifiers, so provides gentle but reliable adhesion around uneven stoma areas. Our Manuka honey infused products have received dermatological accreditation from the Skin Health Alliance. This means you can be confident and assured that our products meet the highest standards of skin safety. Versatile and adaptable HyperSeal moulds around all body contours. They can be stretched, shaped, moulded, or cut to fit around the stoma, ensuring a secure fit. Long-lasting adhesion HyperSeal Mouldable Seals with Manuka Honey maintain their stickiness and can be re-joined if they break, providing reliable adhesion and maintaining effectiveness to provide security for the stoma pouch.

Gentle and effective. Welland Stoma Paste is alcohol-free and hypoallergenic, ensuring it won’t cause stinging or irritation upon application. It’s suitable for most skin types, providing comfort and peace of mind. Smooth and secure seal. Its unique formula smooths and levels minor skin irregularities, creating a perfect base for your stoma bag. By creating this perfect seal, the risk of leaks behind the flange is reduced, preventing related skin irritation and damage. Easy application. The soft, squeezable tube makes applying Welland Stoma Paste effortless. It remains pliable throughout application, allowing for flexibility in moulding and smoothing over scar lines. Long-lasting performance. Welland Stoma Paste offers durable and long-lasting performance, providing a secure hold for your stoma bag throughout the day. Its reliable adhesion prevents leakage and helps prevent sore skin, promoting overall comfort and confidence. Compatibility. Compatible with both one-piece and two-piece stoma pouches and systems, Welland Stoma Paste is versatile and adaptable to various ostomy care routines. This compatibility ensures it can be seamlessly integrated into your preferred stoma care routine.

For flush or recessed stomas that need gentle support to help bring the stoma out into the pouch. Suitable for people whose stoma sits level with or below the skin, or who have skin creases and folds that can make getting a secure fit more challenging. Irrigation cadence, medicine and irrigation, device lifetime and pin code questions. Q: How often should I perform TAI? A: At the start it is common to irrigate once every day for the first 10-14 days. Later on, the frequency may possibly be reduced to once every other day or every third day. The frequency should be decided in consultation with a healthcare professional. Q: Can I stop using stool modifying medicine when I start using Navina Irrigation System? A: TAI is usually part of a bowel management program. It is possible that you may be able to reduce the amount of laxative they are using eventually but you may have to continue using some to ensure that the stools have the right consistency to ensure easy evacuation. It is best to continue with your current laxative regimen until you are getting regular results from TAI. Consult a healthcare professional before changing your personal regimen. Q: How long does the procedure take? A: It is very individual but the aim is that the bowel management routine will take less than one hour. For some people the results are fast and emptying of the bowel is complete. For others it will be more time consuming and the bowel empties intermi

Symptoms questions in conjunction with irrigation. Q: What if bleeding should occur? A: A small amount of bleeding or smearing of blood on the cone may occur and should not alarm you. More severe or sustained rectal bleeding with or without pain suggests a possible bowel perforation, which should be treated as a medical emergency and requires immediate medical attention. Q: What should I do if I feel pain? A: If cramps, discomfort, or pain occur while instilling the water, pause instillation for a few moments and continue more slowly once the discomfort has subsided, ensure that the water is warm enough, at body temperature. If pain is severe or persistent stop the irrigation immediately. It could be perforation of the bowel which should be treated as a medical emergency. Q: What if I feel sweating, palpitations or dizziness during irrigation? A: If you have a spinal cord injury this may be a sign of autonomic dysreflexia. Instill the water slowly and limit the time on the toilet depending on tolerance. Commonly known as Alligator or Hartmann forceps, after German physician Arthur Hartmann, each instrument has a matt black finish with small jaws that allow accurate clinical precision and control. The Crocodile forceps are sterilised and come individually sealed. It is a disposable instrument intended for single-use and comes in four sizes, including a fine jaw variant for paediatric ear care.

products.name: Aria Lateral Tilt Bed and Dolphin Therapy

detail.description: This unique bed and surface duo combines full platform lateral tilt and exceptional immersion. It offers an ideal solution for the most complex patients, in both critical care and general ward environments. In addition to outstanding pressure area care, benefits include easier patient repositioning and care, and improved caregiver efficiency.

Designed for full compatibility with the Medstrom Solo Luxe bed frame, the advanced construction of the Protecta Luxe offers enhanced skin and pressure ulcer protection for a wide variety of patients.

For a growing patient population with complex mental and physical problems, there’s a need for mattress solutions that prioritise safety without compromising on clinical outcomes. The Protecta 7 has been specifically designed as a solution to these challenges, providing enhanced skin protection in even the most high-risk scenarios.
Uniquely suitable for children, adults and adults with atypical anatomy, the Solo Luxe offers enhanced protection and safety for all.

It’s time for change. The ECO portable patient shower is the future of patient hygiene, utilising innovative hydro-molecular technology. The result? Patient dignity and experience restored, up to 65% reduction in caregiver time and up to 95% water reduction than a traditional bed bath.

The 360Care+ Package is an innovative rental package that provides effective falls management and safe mobilisation, increases nursing efficiency and improves patient outcomes.
As the temperatures drop, Medstrom is here to support with escalation preparation.

The Medstrom Aria cushion is designed to be ultra-portable and compact, with its own control unit accompanied by a 12-hour battery life to acknowledge the drawbacks with traditional systems. Equipped with an ultra-low profile of just 6.5cm and innovative cubed cells, the cushion ensures safe mobilisation to and from a chair without compromising on therapeutic benefits.
A unique and highly versatile hospital bed with an unrivalled height range for maximum patient and caregiver safety.
Medstrom is here to support you over the festive period with specialist product rental, equipped with round-the-clock clinical and technical support.
Discover the Aria Junior, specifically designed for paediatrics, providing optimal therapy and immersion whilst enhancing comfort.
Discover the advanced semi-dynamic support surface that offers immediate protection from pressure ulcers and behaves like a dynamic mattress, even in non-powered mode.

Understanding the risks involved in safeguarding both clients and caregivers, the SoloMH bed is an innovative four-section, electric profiling bed frame that has several adaptations to optimise safety and provide enhanced protection.

Optima Juve is a therapeutic support system suitable for both the treatment of existing pressure ulcers category I-IV as well as for children who have been assessed to be at high risk from complications of immobility. The surface compromises two layers of air cells, with the top layer being pre-filled to allow greater immersion. The closed air system automatically adjusts to individual patient weight, providing excellent pressure redistribution.

A unique combination of full platform lateral tilt with unrivalled immersion. This helps improve outcomes, enhance patient care, and increase caregiver efficiency, both inside and outside intensive care.
Clinically and technologically advanced fluid immersion simulation therapy has transformed the prevention and treatment of pressure ulcers for the most complex patients.

Equipped with a unique and patented valve system and semi-dynamic technology, P.R.O. Matt Plus in non-powered mode, is able to achieve a pressure profile similar to that of a dynamic air mattress. This offers significantly higher therapy than a foam mattress and a traditional hybrid system and means patients are protected immediately. If the patient requires a ‘step up’, cell-in-cell technology allows a control unit to be added, converting the system to powered therapy and uniquely offering both alternating and continuous low pressure.

The Neo is one of the only surfaces available specifically designed for neonates that have been compromised and at high risk of skin breakdown. The intelligent controller registers individual patient weight to provide a reactive support surface, even for the smallest of babies. Two versions available for compatibility with incubators and infant warmers.

The TurnCair low air loss mattress provides a high specification of support surface for pressure redistribution, plus a TurnAssist feature that enables safe handling of patients. The TurnAssist feature facilitates easy manual handling for personal care and positional changes, easy changes of linen, inserting slide sheets and positional changes that can be carried out with one nurse.
A unique and highly versatile hospital bed with an unrivalled height range for maximum patient and caregiver safety.

detail.description: Polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP) is an exclusive surface treatment applied to FCI lacrimal products to improve the hydrophilic properties of silicone. The benefit of such a treatment is to enhance the efficiency of tear drainage and to limit the accumulation of debris at the surface of our silicone intubations and PVP perforated plugs. FCI PVP perforated plugs are used to treat excessive tearing due to partial occlusion of punctum and punctal stenosis. They act as a conformer by keeping the punctal opening dilated for several weeks, allowing tears to be drained through. Details: PVP Perforated Plugs • Designed by J.-A. Bernard, M.D. • Slanted collarette for a perfect anatomical fit against the eyelid margin • Exclusive polishing for a perfectly smooth surface • Preloaded on a disposable plug inserter to facilitate the insertion • Option with PVP coating for superior tear drainage • 2 models available • Sterile, Single use * Th Malet, B Challier, N David, A Bertrand, J-L George “Clinical and scintigraphic comparison of silicone and polyvinylpyrrolidone coated silicone perforated plugs”. Br J Ophthalmol 1998;82:1416–1419. The PVP perforated plugs are Class IIb medical devices manufactured by FCI S.A.S. – Notified Body: GMED CE n°0459.

Punctum dilator and plug inserter FCI punctum dilator and plug inserter is necessary for the plug insertion of the Masterka®, Monoka®, Mini-Monoka®, self-threading Monoka® & Monoka of Fayet® plugs. The Disposable Precivia® Device Precivia Device is a tried and tested disposable device that simplifies* intravitreal injections. The Precivia Device is the gold standard for all intravitreal injections. Precivia Device Notes: An intravitreal injection is a shot of medicine into injected into the eye. The inside of the eye is filled with a jelly-like fluid (vitreous). During this procedure, a health care provider injects medicine into the vitreous, near the retina at the back of the eye. The medicine can treat certain eye problems and help protect your vision. This method is most often used to get a higher level of medicine to the retina. *References: Ratnarajan G, Nath R, Appaswamy S, et al. It is designed to reduce operating time and trauma for the patients, either in the intubation phase as well as for the removal of the device. The intubation is self-retaining thanks to two wider silicone portions on the silicone tube. The surgical procedure is similar to the conventional Ritleng® lacrimal intubation and involves the use of Ritleng® instruments. • Regular 0.64mmsilicone tube for a comfortable fit in the intrapalpebral loop • Wider 0.94 mm silicone segments to be positioned in the lacrimal sac ensuring the self-retaining feature of the intubation: no need tomake knots in the nasal fossa • Blackmark to control the central placement and correct positioning of the silicone tube between the two punctums • Easy removal fromthe nose • Require Ritleng® instruments (S1.1460, S1.1470, S1.1480) The Ritleng®+ intubation systemis a Class IIbmedical devicemanufactured by FCI S.A.S. – Notified Body: GMED CE n°0459.

Ritleng® intubation system consists of a silicone (or PVP) tube connected at each extremity to a Poly Ether Ether Ketone (PEEK) thread guide to reduce time and trauma in lacrimal duct intubation surgery. The procedure involves inserting the hollow Ritleng® Probe into the nasolacrimal duct and feeding the thin PEEK thread through it. The probe is then withdrawn, leaving the PEEK to pull the silicone tubing into place. • Less traumatic for patients • Easy retrieval from the nose • Medical grade silicone – PVP option • Sterile The Ritleng® lacrimal intubation set is a Class IIb medical device manufactured by FCI S.A.S. – Notified Body: GMED CE n°0459.

Rapid screening test for Chlamydia trachomatis infection. The Chlamydia trachomatis Antigen Rapid Test Cassette is a qualitative lateral flow immunoassay designed for the detection of Chlamydia trachomatis antigen in clinical specimens such as urine or swabs, depending on the test configuration. Chlamydia infection is often asymptomatic, making screening an essential part of sexual health programmes. This rapid test delivers results within minutes, supporting timely identification and referral for further clinical management. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

Rapid semi‑quantitative screening of prostate‑specific antigen levels. The PSA Rapid Test Cassette is a semi‑quantitative lateral flow immunoassay for the detection of prostate‑specific antigen (PSA) in whole blood, serum or plasma. Elevated PSA levels may be associated with prostate cancer, benign prostatic hyperplasia or prostatitis. This test provides rapid screening results to support early clinical assessment and monitoring in professional healthcare and urology settings. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

Rapid powder screening for synthetic nitazene opioids in harm reduction and forensic settings The Nitazene Powder Test Cassette is a rapid immunoassay device designed to screen dissolved powder samples for the presence of nitazenes. Nitazines are a group of potent synthetic opioids increasingly associated with fatal overdose incidents. Operating at a cut-off of 2000 ng/mL, the cassette delivers a visual result in 5 minutes from a prepared powder solution, without laboratory analysis. It is a valuable tool for drug checking services, harm reduction organisations, forensic drug testing teams and law enforcement agencies seeking to identify high-risk synthetic opioids in seized or submitted substances. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

Rapid urine test for GHB detection at 10 µg/mL for clinical and forensic use The gamma-hydroxybutyrate (GHB) Test Cassette is a rapid immunoassay device that detects GHB in urine at a cut-off of 10 µg/mL. GHB is a central nervous system depressant associated with recreational misuse and drug-facilitated sexual assault. Because GHB clears from the body rapidly, often within 4-8 hours of ingestion, fast testing is critical in clinical and forensic settings. The cassette format requires only 3 drops of urine and delivers a clear visual result in 5 minutes, making it practical for emergency departments, sexual assault referral centres (SARCs) and forensic drug testing programmes. For professional use only

Rapid urine testing for Nicotine and Tobacco exposure screening The Cotinine Cassette is a rapid immunoassay test that detects cotinine – the primary metabolite of nicotine – in urine. As the main breakdown product of nicotine from tobacco and e-cigarettes, cotinine provides a reliable biomarker for tobacco and nicotine product use. Results are available within minutes with no laboratory equipment required, making the test practical for smoking cessation programmes, occupational health checks and insurance or pre-employment screening. Available in two cut-off configurations to suit different screening requirements: COT100 (100 ng/mL) for sensitive detection of light exposure; COT200 (200 ng/mL) for standard smoking status screening. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

Rapid, portable surface drug test for detecting trace drug residues from powders or surfaces, with results in 5 minutes DrugTrace is a non-invasive, surface-based drug residue detection test that screens for 8 drug classes from swabbed surfaces or dissolved powder samples. No biological specimen is required from individuals. The 8 panel test simultaneously detects amphetamine, cocaine, fentanyl, ketamine, MDMA, methamphetamine, opiates and cannabis from a single surface swab and buffer solution. Results are available in 5 minutes. DrugTrace is designed for prisons, probation services, workplaces, border control, law enforcement and any setting where surface contamination monitoring or non-invasive drug detection is required. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

Chain of Custody hair sample collection kit for confirmatory laboratory drug testing The Hair Drug Confirmation Kit is a complete professional collection kit for gathering, packaging and despatching hair samples to an accredited laboratory for confirmatory drug testing. Hair testing provides a significantly longer detection window than urine or oral fluid. A standard 3 cm head hair sample reflects approximately 0-3 months of drug use history, and extended history testing is possible with longer samples. The kit is used in workplace investigations, child safeguarding assessments, legal proceedings, insurance programmes and any situation where a robust, defensible, long-window drug use history is required. The kit includes all materials for a standardised, Chain of Custody compliant collection. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

products.name: Covid-19 IgG/IgM Antibody Rapid Test Cassette

detail.description: Rapid screening of IgG and IgM antibodies to SARS‑CoV‑2. The COVID‑19 IgG/IgM Rapid Test Cassette is a lateral flow immunoassay designed for the qualitative detection of IgG and IgM antibodies to SARS‑CoV‑2 in whole blood, serum or plasma samples. These antibodies may be present following previous exposure to the virus or as part of an immune response. IgM antibodies typically appear earlier in the immune response, while IgG antibodies may persist for a longer period. Combined IgG/IgM detection supports antibody screening and serological assessment when interpreted alongside clinical evaluation and patient history. The test delivers results within minutes using a simple cassette format suitable for point‑of‑care and laboratory settings. The COVID‑19 IgG/IgM Rapid Test Cassette is intended for professional in vitro diagnostic use only and should not be used for the diagnosis of acute SARS‑CoV‑2 infection. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

Rapid saliva alcohol screening using a simple dip and read test strip. The Alcohol Rapid Test Strip is a simple, instrument‑free solution for the qualitative detection of alcohol in saliva. Based on enzymatic oxidation technology, the strip produces a colour change proportional to alcohol concentration, covering a range from 0.02% to 0.30%. Designed for professional use, it delivers fast, easy‑to‑interpret results within minutes, making it suitable for workplace screening, occupational health programmes and on‑site alcohol checks where immediate decision‑making is required. For professional use only . Please refer to the references page for information on alcohol cut‑off levels.

7 parameter urine validity strips for detecting specimen tampering and substitution Adulteration Strips are rapid test strips that simultaneously assess 7 specimen validity parameters from a single urine dip, helping to identify samples that may have been tampered with, diluted or substituted. Parameters include pH, creatinine, nitrites, bleach, glutaraldehyde, PCC (pyridinium chlorochromate) and specific gravity. Detecting adulterated specimens is a critical quality control step in drug testing programmes, particularly in workplace and forensic settings where the integrity of results must be assured. Strips deliver clear colour-change results immediately after dipping, with no additional equipment required. For professional use only

Simple temperature verification for urine specimens This single-use temperature strip attaches to a urine specimen container and gives an immediate visual reading to confirm the sample is within the expected body temperature range of 32-39°C. Checking specimen temperature is a straightforward way to detect samples that may have been substituted or tampered with during collection. It is a standard part of many workplace and forensic drug testing protocols. For professional use only

On the spot screening for GHB, ketamine and benzodiazepines in drinks DrinkSpike is a rapid 3 panel dip card test that screens drinks for three substances most commonly associated with drink spiking: GHB (gamma-hydroxybutyrate), ketamine and benzodiazepines. The card is simply dipped into the suspect drink and results are read in 5 minutes. No specialist knowledge, equipment or laboratory is required. DrinkSpike is compact, discreet and designed for use in bars, clubs, universities, events and any setting where personal safety is a priority. It can be used on alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

Chain of Custody urine drug confirmation kit for laboratory verified drug test results. The Urine Drug Confirmation Kit is a professional grade sample collection and packaging kit used to send urine specimens to an accredited laboratory for confirmatory drug testing. Designed to meet Chain of Custody requirements, it is suitable for workplace investigations, clinical settings, legal proceedings and forensic drug testing where a defensible, laboratory confirmed result is required. The kit contains all necessary components for secure, tamper-evident sample collection, sealing and despatch. Confirmatory analysis is performed using LC-MS/MS or equivalent technology at an approved laboratory. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

Fast, donor friendly oral fluid drug test for on-site, rehab and clinical screening. SureSwab Rapid is a streamlined oral fluid drug screening device designed for faster collection and quicker results than standard oral fluid tests. A click-activated swab mechanism ensures accurate sample insertion, while a red saturation indicator confirms sufficient saliva collection in as little as 30 seconds. Available in a 7 panel configuration covering amphetamine, benzodiazepines, cocaine, methamphetamine, ketamine, opiates and cannabis. SureSwab Rapid is CE-marked and suitable for workplace, occupational health and on-site drug testing where speed and ease of use are critical. Results are available in 10 minutes. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

products.name: On Call® Blood Glucose & Ketone Monitoring System

detail.description: Integrated blood glucose and ketone monitoring system for routine metabolic health management. The On Call® Blood Glucose & Ketone Monitoring System supports routine monitoring of blood glucose and β‑ketone levels using compatible test strips and a dual‑function meter. Designed for wellness and metabolic health management, the system enables regular monitoring to support diabetes management and ketone awareness. Components are intended for in vitro diagnostic use with capillary whole blood samples and provide clear, digital results when used according to the relevant Instructions for Use. For self testing and professional use

Rapid semi‑quantitative screening of C‑reactive protein (CRP) to support the assessment of inflammation and infection risk. The CRP semi-quantitative rapid test cassette is designed to provide fast and accurate measurement of C-reactive protein, supporting infection and inflammation assessment in professional healthcare settings. The test cassette is a lateral flow immunoassay designed for the detection of C‑reactive protein (CRP) in whole blood, serum or plasma samples. CRP is a non‑specific inflammatory marker that may be elevated in response to infection, tissue injury or inflammatory disease. The test delivers a semi-quantitative result by categorising CRP concentrations into clinically relevant ranges. This supports the assessment and monitoring of inflammatory conditions and may assist healthcare professionals in evaluating the likelihood of bacterial infection when interpreted alongside clinical findings and other diagnostic information. Results are available within minutes using a simple cassette format suitable for both point-of-care and laboratory environments. The test is designed for professional use and provides a rapid screening solution where timely inflammation assessment is required. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

Convenient midstream urine test for rapid hCG detection. The Pregnancy Test Midstream is a rapid, one‑step lateral flow immunoassay for the qualitative detection of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) in urine. The midstream format allows direct urine application without the need for additional collection devices, providing a convenient option for pregnancy screening in professional and supervised settings. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only.

Dip‑and‑read urine pregnancy test strip for hCG detection. The hCG Pregnancy Rapid Test Strip is a qualitative lateral flow immunoassay designed to detect human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) in urine specimens. The strip format offers a simple, cost‑effective solution for high‑volume pregnancy screening in professional settings. Results are available within minutes and are intended as a preliminary screening aid. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only.

Rapid qualitative detection of hCG to support early pregnancy screening. The hCG Pregnancy Rapid Test Cassette is a qualitative lateral flow immunoassay designed for the detection of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) in urine, serum or plasma specimens. hCG is produced shortly after implantation and is an established marker for early pregnancy detection. This test provides clear results within minutes and supports use in professional clinical and laboratory settings as a screening aid for pregnancy. For professional in vitro use only

products.name: Transferrin & Faecal Occult Blood Rapid Test Cassette

detail.description: Dual detection of occult blood and transferrin in stool samples. The Transferrin & Faecal Occult Blood Rapid Test Cassette is a qualitative immunoassay designed to detect both human haemoglobin and transferrin in stool specimens. Combined testing improves the detection of gastrointestinal bleeding from both upper and lower regions of the GI tract. This enhanced screening approach supports early identification of conditions associated with colorectal and upper gastrointestinal cancers. For professional use only

products.name: Group A Streptococcus pyogenes (Strep A) Antigen Rapid Test Cassette

detail.description: Rapid point‑of‑care screening for Group A Streptococcus infection. The Strep A Antigen Rapid Test Cassette detects Group A Streptococcus antigens from throat swab specimens. Producing results within minutes, it supports rapid assessment of streptococcal pharyngitis in clinical and primary care environments. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

products.name: Influenza (Flu) A/B Antigen Combo Rapid Test Cassette

detail.description: Rapid point‑of‑care screening for Influenza A and Influenza B from a nasal swab. The Influenza A/B Antigen Rapid Test Cassette is a lateral flow immunoassay designed for the qualitative detection of Influenza A and Influenza B antigens from nasal swab specimens. Delivering clear results within minutes, it supports fast clinical decision‑making during respiratory infection assessment. The test is intended for professional use in point‑of‑care settings such as GP practices, clinics and healthcare environments where rapid differentiation of influenza types is required. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

products.name: Covid-19 Antigen Rapid Test Cassette – Gold

detail.description: Reliable, rapid screening for SARS‑CoV‑2 antigen from nasal swab samples. The COVID‑19 Antigen Rapid Test Cassette is a lateral flow immunoassay designed for the qualitative detection of SARS‑CoV‑2 antigen from nasal swab specimens. Antigen testing supports the screening of individuals with suspected acute infection and aids infection control decision‑making when used alongside clinical assessment. Results are available within minutes using a simple cassette format suitable for point‑of‑care and laboratory settings. The test is intended for professional in vitro diagnostic use only and should not be used as the sole basis for diagnosis or patient management. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

products.name: Faecal Occult Blood Rapid Test Cassette

detail.description: Rapid stool test for the qualitative detection of faecal occult blood. The Faecal Occult Blood (FOB) Rapid Test Cassette is a qualitative lateral flow immunoassay for the detection of human haemoglobin in faecal specimens. The presence of occult blood in stool may indicate gastrointestinal bleeding associated with conditions such as colorectal cancer, polyps or ulcers. The test delivers fast results at the point of care and does not require dietary restrictions, making it suitable for routine screening and early clinical assessment in professional healthcare settings. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

products.name: Helicobacter Pylori Antigen Rapid Test Cassette

detail.description: Rapid stool antigen screening for active Helicobacter pylori infection. The H. pylori Antigen Rapid Test Cassette detects Helicobacter pylori antigens in stool specimens, supporting diagnosis of gastrointestinal infection associated with ulcers and gastritis. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

products.name: Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) Antigen Rapid Test Cassette

detail.description: Rapid point‑of‑care RSV antigen detection from nasal swab specimens. The RSV Antigen Rapid Test Cassette is a lateral flow immunoassay for the qualitative detection of Respiratory Syncytial Virus antigens from nasal swab specimens. RSV is a common cause of respiratory infection, particularly in infants, young children and older adults. This test delivers clear results within minutes, supporting timely clinical assessment and infection management in professional healthcare settings. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

Urine alcohol screening using ETG for extended detection after drinking. The ETG Urine Alcohol Test is a rapid screening test designed to detect ethyl glucuronide (EtG), a direct metabolite of alcohol, in urine at a cut‑off of 1000 ng/mL. Unlike saliva or breath tests that indicate recent alcohol use, ETG testing extends the detection window, identifying alcohol consumption for up to several days after drinking. The test is suited to professional screening programmes where alcohol abstinence or compliance monitoring is required, including workplace testing, occupational health and rehabilitation settings. Results are available within minutes using a simple dip and read format. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on alcohol cut‑off levels.

products.name: SARS-CoV-2 & Influenza (Flu) A/B Antigen Combo Rapid Test Cassette

detail.description: Combined antigen screening for Covid‑19 and Influenza A/B from one sample. The first dual test in the UK to be awarded CTDA approval. The SARS‑CoV‑2 & Influenza A/B Antigen Combo Rapid Test Cassette is a lateral flow immunoassay designed to detect Covid‑19 and Influenza A/B antigens from a single nasal swab. This combined approach supports efficient differential diagnosis of respiratory infections at the point of care, delivering fast results to aid clinical decision‑making. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

Advanced breath alcohol screening with optional printed results. The Intoximeter is a professional breath alcohol screening device designed for organisations requiring enhanced functionality and robust testing workflows. Using fuel cell sensor technology, it delivers fast and consistent BrAC screening results from breath samples. In addition to direct breath testing, the Intoximeter supports passive and drink sniffer modes, allowing screening without a direct mouthpiece blow. Optional integrated printing provides immediate hard‑copy records, making the device suitable for structured workplace, clinical and compliance‑driven alcohol screening programmes. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on alcohol cut‑off levels.

Reliable breath alcohol screening using fuel cell sensor technology. The Alcometer is a professional breath alcohol tester designed to provide fast, reliable screening for alcohol using advanced fuel cell sensor technology. Measuring breath alcohol concentration (BrAC) across a range of 0.00 to 2.00 mg/L, it delivers clear digital results within seconds. Its compact, easy‑to‑use design makes it suitable for workplace screening, occupational health programmes and on‑site alcohol testing where quick, preliminary results are required. Built‑in warning indicators support alcohol policy thresholds while maintaining straightforward operation for professional users. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on alcohol cut‑off levels.

Dip‑and‑read urine reagent strips for rapid multiparameter screening. Urinalysis Reagent Strips are dip‑and‑read test strips designed for the rapid qualitative and semi‑quantitative detection of multiple parameters in urine, including glucose, protein, blood, ketones, pH, nitrite and leukocytes. Results provide valuable information relating to general metabolic status, kidney and urinary tract function, and overall health. These strips are intended for professional in vitro diagnostic use and can be read visually using a colour chart or instrumentally with urine chemistry analysers. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

Non-invasive oral fluid multi-drug test for workplace and rehabilitation screening. SureSwab is an oral fluid (saliva) drug screening device that detects multiple drugs of abuse without the need for urine collection or restroom facilities. Using a sponge collector, the donor provides a saliva sample which is transferred to the integrated test cassette. A collection indicator confirms that sufficient sample has been obtained. Available in 8 and 10 panel configurations, SureSwab is CE marked and designed for use in workplace drug testing, ‘for cause’ testing, rehabilitation programmes and any setting where observed, non-invasive collection is important. Results are available in 10 minutes. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

Flexible multi‑drug urine screening from a single low‑volume sample. The Multi‑cassette urine drug test offers flexible multi‑drug screening using individual cassettes from a single urine specimen. Designed for low sample volumes, it allows specific drug combinations to be tested simultaneously with results available in minutes. Its modular format is well suited to workplaces, laboratories and clinical settings requiring adaptable screening options. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

Targeted, cost‑effective urine drug screening with fast, reliable results. The Single Drug Test Strip provides a simple and cost effective solution for targeted urine drug screening where only one analyte is required. Designed for professional use, it delivers clear visual results in minutes without the need for laboratory equipment. Its compact format makes it ideal for high volume testing programmes, workplace screening and clinical settings requiring focused testing for specific drugs. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

High throughput dip‑and‑read urine drug screening in a single device. The Multi‑panel urine drug test houses multiple test strips in one dip‑and‑read device, enabling simultaneous screening for several drug classes. Designed for high throughput environments, it delivers results in minutes while reducing handling and simplifying workflow. Its robust construction and clear visual cues support consistent use in workplace and clinical screening programmes. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

Fast, secure urine drug screening with integrated testing strips. The Rapid Cup is an all in one urine drug test cup designed for fast on‑site screening. Integrated test strips and built in validity indicators streamline the collection to result process, reducing handling and delivering results within minutes. Its secure, leak resistant design makes it ideal for workplace, clinical and mobile testing environments. For professional use only

All in one urine drug test cup with enhanced specimen security and rapid results. The Integrated Key Cup combines urine collection and multi‑drug screening in a single secure device. A built‑in activation key controls test initiation, reducing handling and supporting sample integrity. With clear results available in minutes and integrated validity checks, it is widely used in workplace, occupational health and forensic screening programmes where security, speed and ease of use are essential. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

Regulated Disinfectant Cleaner. PT2 Disinfectant – BPR Registered. pH neutral. Achieves full disinfection in just 1 minute. Eliminates the pre-cleaning step entirely, reducing time, chemical usage, and the risk of cross-contamination between cleaning and disinfection stages. Designed to deliver excellent surface aesthetics on a range of surfaces. Benefitting from properties such as: Low residue, low tackiness, low streaking (high gloss and low haze), compatible with alcohol-sensitive surfaces. Safe on a wide range of materials including plastics, rubber, glass, and metal alloys, without the surface damage risks associated with acidic or alkaline disinfectants. Should not be used on Brass, Copper and Mild Steel.

detail.description: Principles of the 'SAIPH ® Medially Stabilised' Knee Information for healthcare professionals Tibiofemoral Articulation The SAIPH® Knee design is based on the principle of medial stability in the normal knee, which has been described in historical literature 2 and widely in recent literature 3,4,5 . In normal, healthy knees the shapes of the medial and lateral tibial condyles are different: the medial side is concave; the lateral side is convex. Stability is provided collectively by the collateral ligaments (MCL and LCL), both cruciate ligaments (ACL and PCL) and the menisci. The shapes of the articular surfaces and the arrangement of stabilising soft tissue structures collectively provide greater stability about the medial condyle. Knee flexion is accompanied by axial rotation of the femur with respect to the tibia, which is achieved with a limited freedom for antero-posterior (AP) movement of the lateral femoral condyle relative to the tibia. Stability throughout flexion is crucial to normal knee function: a knee with a deficient ACL or medial meniscus, for example, is likely to be unstable and may require corrective surgery. detail.description: Development of Modern-Day Hip Resurfacing Information for healthcare professionals Modern-day hip resurfacing is based on observations of patients with large diameter metal-on-metal (MoM) total hip prostheses such as the McKee-Farrar and the Ring Hip (Figure 1), who retained functioning hips with very little wear for more than 30 years after their operation 3 . Finsbury (now MatOrtho ® ) was involved in the development of the Birmingham Hip Resurfacing (BHR), which was based on study of the successful devices and the application of modern manufacturing techniques. Since its first use in 1997, thousands of successful hip resurfacing procedures have been performed around the world. Figure 1: Historical MoM prosthesis: the Ring Hip implanted 1964–1979. The ADEPT ® Hip Resurfacing System was developed using the knowledge gained by direct involvement in the BHR and the extensive research of historical MoM devices, and as the original manufacturer of the BHR 3 , manufacturing over 200,000 BHR devices. detail.description: Clinical Heritage: Success of the MRK™ Information for healthcare professionals Clinical Heritage: Success of the MRK™ The MRK™, also manufactured by MatOrtho® (previously Finsbury), is the original 1994 ‘medial ball-and-socket knee’ and remains in popular use. The clinical success of the MRK™ has strong relevance as a ‘proof of concept’ to the expected long-term outcomes for the SAIPH® Knee, which is an evolution of the original design. Overall, the MRK™ has been shown to provide greater inherent stability than comparator devices 18,19,20 . Patients with a medially stabilised knee notice the difference, and express that they prefer the design over posterior substituting (PS), cruciate retaining (CR) and mobile designs, citing feelings of stability, normality and strength on stairs as reasons for their preference 21,22 . With its lateralised trochlea 11 the MRK™ exhibits a more normal patellar function 12 . It provides better restoration of ROM when compared to a standard PS knee design 23 and mean ROM is equal that of a ‘high-flex’ knee 24 . When compared to all other TKR designs, NJR collected patient reported outcome measures (PROMs) show that the benefits of the MRK™ are reflec

Orthopaedic Data Evaluation Panel (ODEP) Information for healthcare professionals ODEP provide a service evaluation for TKR ratings and award ratings based on ongoing assessment of implant performance (rate of revision), and the number of patients for which principally UK data is available. The registries and clinical studies described in this document report excellent rates of survivorship for the SAIPH® Knee, with cumulative revision rates lower than the average TKR revision rates and among the lowest of all available devices 17,43,45 . Within the MatOrtho® philosophy for safe introduction of new technology, the SAIPH® Knee was released with limited availability and under closely monitored use over the first 10 years. To ensure versions of implant brands are reported appropriately, ODEP separate devices into their available constructs. For the SAIPH® Knee, this means separating UK data for SAIPH® Knee procedures with no patella, with a cementless patella and with a cemented patella. Consequently, cohorts on which ODEP ratings are based for each construct remain small. The SAIPH® Knee is most commonly used in the UK without a patella resurfacing and so a longer rating is available

Hip Resurfacing: Factors Influencing Survival Information for healthcare professionals Appropriate device design is an essential factor for the performance of a hip resurfacing device. Different metallurgy, clearance, geometry and fixation are proven to affect clinical outcome and, consequently, results have differed greatly between devices (Figure 6a). Of the devices shown in Figure 6a, only the ADEPT ® and BHR are the original ‘modern-day’ hip resurfacing implants with the same clearance, metallurgy, geometry and fixation based on analysis of the successful early MoM devices and both manufactured by Finsbury (now MatOrtho ® ; BHR manufactured from start until 2009). Now only the ADEPT® is provided by the original manufacturers (MatOrtho ® ). Some have also produced cementless component versions. Higher revision rates 17,43 , particularly tibial loosening 44 have been associated with these combined design characteristics. The MRK™ and SAIPH ® Knees include a different fixation design to traditional keel designs, which is intended to support rotational torque at the implant-bone interface. The first clinical follow up on MRK™ patients who had received the implant from 1994 commented specifically on the matter and showed that the increased congruence of the asymmetric tibial bearing had not increased the rate of loosening 15 . detail.description: Clinical Function of the SAIPH ® Knee Information for healthcare professionals Normal Pattern of Movement (Knee Kinematics) Balancing stability with freedom of movement is a principal goal of TKR design. How well a TKR achieves this can be determined by evaluating the pattern of movement in patients’ knees during well-selected activities. To evaluate the kinematics of the SAIPH® Knee, a consecutive series of one surgeon’s first 14 patients (mean 69 years old, range 51-83), with no exclusions were assessed using video fluoroscopy at a minimum 24 months postoperatively 7 . Study participants were asked to perform clinically relevant functional activities, including: a full internal-to-external pivot standing on the affected leg to show the AP extents of medial and lateral condyles with large torque while under load; a kneeling activity to establish full passive flexion; lunge and step-up/down activities to establish ROM and AP stability in both condyles for the loaded knee. In all activities the SAIPH® Knee exhibited an asymmetric pattern of movement: the knee was AP stable on the medial side and lateral translation was permitted when required (Figure 1) 7 .
