The motion sprint 900 PL is the result of decades of development and close collaboration between leading research institutions and elite sports organisations. This high-performance treadmill is designed to meet the rigorous demands of professional users, delivering a platform where clinical accuracy meets the intensity of competitive sports diagnostics. High-Torque Performance and Cushioned Stability Equipped with a powerful motor system, the motion sprint 900 PL ensures exceptional synchronisation and highly precise, reproducible speed regulation. Unlike the lamella models, the PL utilises a high-quality nubbed tread belt, specifically engineered to provide superior cushioning and joint protection during high-intensity sessions. This ensures that even at peak performance, the impact on the patient’s or athlete’s musculoskeletal system is minimised. Bespoke Customisation for Specialised Care The motion sprint 900 PL is uniquely versatile, offering a vast array of specialised accessories to suit diverse clinical and athletic needs. From reinforced handrails and forearm supports to safety brackets for fall protection, the system can be tailored to provide a secure environment for any user. Additionally, the option for running direction reversal and integrated communication interfaces makes this treadmill a professional-grade tool for highly specialised diagnostic applications.

Here is the edited copy for the motion sprint 900 SE, maintaining the professional and clinical tone consistent with your treadmill range while clearly distinguishing its specific feature set. The motion sprint 900 SE: Professional Slat-Technology for Level-Ground Training The motion sprint 900 SE is a robust, professional-grade treadmill featuring advanced lamella (slat) technology. Engineered for clinics and training facilities that require a high-performance, flat-surface running environment, the SE model provides the same exceptional joint protection and mechanical precision as the rest of the 900 series. Superior Impact Absorption and Mechanical Efficiency The running surface is composed of 60 individual slats, each laterally mounted on high-precision ball bearings. This allows the lamellas to react dynamically to every step, creating a “swing” effect that significantly reduces impact forces on the patient’s joints. The low-friction design of the slat system ensures remarkably smooth synchronisation and allows for consistent operation at ultra-low speeds starting from just 0.1 km/h—ideal for early-stage gait training and neurological rehabilitation. While this specific model is designed for level-ground exercise (no inclination), it offers a standard speed range up to 17.0 km/h, with an optional performance package available to reach 22 km/h.

The motion sprint 900 SL is a robust, high-performance treadmill engineered with advanced lamella (slat) technology. Designed for both clinical rehabilitation and professional athletic training, it provides a superior running surface that prioritises joint protection and mechanical precision. Advanced Lamella Engineering for Joint Protection At the heart of the motion sprint 900 SL are 60 individual slats, each laterally mounted on high-precision ball bearings. This allows the running surface to “swing” freely and respond dynamically to every footfall. The result is a highly shock-absorbent surface that optimally protects the patient’s joints while ensuring smooth synchronisation even at low motor power. This low-friction design is particularly beneficial for delicate rehabilitation, as it enables smooth, consistent operation at speeds as low as 0.1 km/h. For higher-intensity diagnostics, the system supports speeds up to 17.0 km/h as standard, with an optional performance package increasing the maximum speed to 22 km/h.

The motion stair 900 is the final component in our comprehensive equipment line, specifically designed to bridge the gap between clinical exercise therapy and functional everyday movement. By simulating the natural action of climbing stairs, it provides a highly effective platform for simultaneous cardiovascular conditioning, muscular strengthening, and the advancement of coordinative skills. Versatile Motion and Enhanced Patient Safety Unlike traditional steppers, the motion stair 900 utilises a pedal-independent system. This allows for a vast variety of movement amplitudes and specialised work tasks, making it an essential tool for training balance and motor coordination. To ensure the system is accessible to the widest possible patient demographic, the frame features a newly designed handrail. This ergonomic support provides a higher degree of security, extending the device’s application to users with compromised balance or weaker coordination. Furthermore, the entry point has been optimised for safer and easier access, ensuring patient confidence from the very start of the session.

The motion body 900 WM provides the full therapeutic power of our premier upper-body trainer in a specialised, wall-mounted configuration. Designed for facilities where space is at a premium, this model maintains all the advanced functionality of the standard motion body 900 while offering a significantly smaller footprint and unhindered access for wheelchair users. Maximum Functionality, Minimal Footprint The motion body 900 WM is the ideal solution for clinics that require a high degree of flexibility without occupying valuable floor space. With a simple, robust installation on any solid wall, the unit becomes a permanent, stable fixture for a wide range of patients. Its impressive 40 cm vertical adjustment range allows clinicians to quickly set the drive axle to the perfect height for seated patients, wheelchair users, or those performing standing exercises. Like its floor-mounted counterpart, it features the ability to switch between asynchronous and synchronous “handibike” modes, ensuring it can handle everything from delicate joint mobilisation to intensive muscle-building protocols.

The motion body 900 is an indispensable component of holistic exercise therapy and integrated cardiovascular training. Specifically designed for active engagement of the upper extremities, this versatile system is ideal for both endurance training and the targeted mobilisation of the arms and shoulders following joint injuries or surgery. Exceptional Versatility and Ergonomics The drive unit features an extensive adjustment range, allowing the axle height to be perfectly positioned for both seated and standing training. The system supports both forward and backward movement, and the standard length-adjustable cranks can be quickly switched to a synchronous “handibike mode.” The asynchronous movement is excellent for shoulder joint and rotator cuff mobilisation, while the synchronous motion sequence is preferred for muscle building and is the optimal training mode for wheelchair users. To ensure maximum safety and comfort, the unit is equipped with Leki® grips. These feature a specialised click mechanism that allows for the use of hand straps or gloves, providing extra security for patients with limited grip strength.

The motion cross 900 is designed to engage the entire body, making it an ideal solution for activating patients with sedentary lifestyles or those requiring low-impact cardiovascular conditioning. Its guided movement pattern ensures a safe and immediate start to training, promoting an upright posture while coordinating upper and lower body movement for maximum therapeutic benefit. Ergonomic Motion and Clinical Safety The system features long cranks and an ergonomic linkage between arm and leg movements, creating a smooth, sweeping stride that mimics natural motion. Unlike many other cross-trainers on the market, the motion cross 900 is engineered for joint-friendly performance and whisper-quiet operation. With its intuitive interface and easy-to-learn movement, the device allows patients to train effectively with minimal supervision, optimising staff resources. Furthermore, the exceptionally low step-on height of just 18 cm makes it one of the most accessible machines in its class for clinical rehabilitation.

The motion relax 900 is a premium recumbent training system engineered for comfort during extended sessions. It is specifically designed to meet the needs of patients with neurological or orthopedic restrictions, as well as those requiring a higher weight capacity. By prioritising ergonomic support, the motion relax 900 ensures that even the most challenging rehabilitation goals remain accessible and safe. Enhanced Accessibility and Specialised Support This latest development features an extended step-through area and a narrow, joint-friendly Q-factor to promote natural movement. To ensure the safety of every patient, the unit is equipped with robust support handles for easy mounting and dismounting, alongside a standard adjustable backrest for personalised lumbar support. For bariatric care, the “Boosted 250” version offers an expanded swivel seat and high-positioned armrests, facilitating easier access and supporting a maximum user weight of 250 kg.

The motion cycle 900 has been meticulously engineered with a focus on biomechanical excellence, meeting the rigorous requirements for both clinical rehabilitation and athletic performance. Designed to provide an optimal, individualized training position, it ensures that every user—regardless of physical stature or mobility—can train safely and effectively. Maximum Accessibility and Ergonomic Flexibility Recognizing the needs of patients with restricted mobility, the motion cycle 900 features a compact housing that allows for a wide, low step-through of approximately 36–41 cm. This deep-axle design ensures effortless mounting and dismounting. The system is highly inclusive, accommodating a vast range of users from children (starting at 135 cm) to tall adults (up to 205 cm). With a narrow Q-factor of no more than 18 cm and a wide range of horizontal and vertical adjustments, the motion cycle 900 provides a natural, joint-friendly pedaling motion tailored to the individual.

The motion cycle 100 med is a robust and medically certified ergometer that is easy to operate and includes the basic functions of a medical training device. It is always manufactured according to the medical directive (EU) 2017/745, class IIa and equipped with a coded pulse receiver, three training programmes, backlight and interface. The included quickstart programme is speed-dependent, the timed training is watt-constant and thus speed-independent. We also consider a pulse-controlled and therefore also speed-independent training programme to be essential for good endurance training. The valuable independence from the power grid avoids annoying tripping hazards and saves electricity. The unit is always equipped with a chip card reader so that training programmes can be stored on customer cards without a PC. The particularly small housing leaves enough space for easy access.

The Blueflow Flow Sensor is a revolutionary advancement in spirometry technology, specifically engineered for Geratherm Respiratory systems. Designed to meet the most stringent international criteria for pulmonary testing, the Blueflow sensor combines the high-precision performance of a gold-standard diagnostic tool with the convenience and safety of a fully disposable product. By utilising a pre-calibrated design, the Blueflow sensor ensures that every test delivers first-class results while providing complete security against cross-contamination, making it an essential component for any modern respiratory laboratory.

detail.description: The Spirostik Blue represents the latest advancement in spirometry from Geratherm Respiratory. A powerful and versatile diagnostic tool, it is designed for use across all clinical environments, from busy hospitals to private practices. Whether used for initial diagnosis, follow-up screening, or severity assessment, the Spirostik Blue is essential for the differential diagnosis of obstructive conditions—such as Asthma, COPD, and Emphysema—as well as restrictive diseases, including pulmonary fibrosis and neuromuscular disorders. Clinical Flexibility and Safety The Spirostik Blue is engineered for the modern clinic. It can function as a standalone device or be networked across multiple practices to centralise patient data. At its core is a pre-calibrated, single-use flow sensor designed with extremely low dead space, significantly improving patient safety and comfort. With its revolutionary snap-in handle, changing sensors is quick, easy, and secure, ensuring your clinic maintains the highest standards of hygiene and efficiency.

The Ambistik CPET builds upon the foundation of the standard Ambistik module, providing a specialised solution for the rigorous demands of Cardiopulmonary Exercise Testing. In addition to monitoring temperature, barometric pressure, and humidity, this advanced module features integrated, continuous measurement of ambient CO2 levels. Precision Performance in High-Activity Environments In a clinical or sports science environment, ambient CO2 levels are rarely static. Factors such as multiple people in a testing room or the high ventilatory output of an athlete during maximal exertion can significantly elevate local CO2 concentrations. By feeding real-time CO2 data directly into the BLUE CHERRY® software suite, the Ambistik CPET compensates for these fluctuations instantly. This ensures that gas exchange calculations remain undisputed, protecting the clinician from data misinterpretation and ensuring the highest level of accuracy for every CPET measurement.

Here is the edited copy for your Bronchial Challenge System, maintaining the professional, high-precision, and clinical tone established for your pulmonary diagnostic range. Bronchial Challenge System: Precision and Safety in Provocation Testing This compact, microprocessor-controlled compressor unit is specifically designed to perform standardised bronchial challenge testing with the highest degree of accuracy. Featuring a medically certified, integrated air compressor, the system operates independently of any external air source, making it a versatile and self-contained solution for modern pulmonary laboratories. Automated Workflow and Clinical Compliance The system is engineered to fulfil all international standards for automated pulmonary testing routines. An integrated LCD screen provides the clinician with real-time information and guides the user through predefined test sequences, ensuring high reproducibility and a streamlined workflow. The low-noise operation of the built-in compressor ensures a calm environment, helping to keep the patient relaxed throughout the provocation protocol. Superior Hygiene and Environmental Protection Patient safety and hygiene are at the forefront of this system’s design. It utilises an advanced 3-way valve system that directs patient airflow precisely, preventing the exhaled air from contaminating the side stream nebuliser and the provocation liquid. Additionally, the system features integrated filtration for exhaled air, protecting the clinical environment and ensuring that both the patient and staff can breathe safely without risk of cross-contamination.

The AMEDTEC Mobile ECG is a high-performance 12-lead resting system designed for the rigours of modern clinical environments. Compact enough to fit in a pocket, it features a brilliant display and is engineered for 24/7 availability, providing immediate diagnostic power wherever the patient is located. With its dedicated docking station for rapid charging, the system is always ready for the next shift. Paperless Efficiency and Hospital Integration Designed specifically for the day-to-day requirements of high-traffic hospitals, the AMEDTEC solution is entirely paperless and free from mechanical moving parts. Its smooth, robust exterior is easy to disinfect, ensuring the highest standards of hygiene during mobile use. The device integrates seamlessly with the AMEDTEC ECGpro® data management system, allowing for the direct transfer of patient data and orders from HIS/PACS or practice software, supporting a truly mobile, digital workflow. System Capabilities Automatic Recording: Supports both standardised resting ECGs and longer-duration rhythm traces. 24/7 Readiness: Includes a rapid-charge docking station to ensure the device is always powered for round-the-clock clinical use. Brilliant Visuals: A high-resolution display provides clear, real-time visualisation of all 12 leads for immediate clinical review.

The Spirostik Blue is the latest advancement in spirometry technology from Geratherm Respiratory, providing a powerful diagnostic tool suitable for everything from large hospitals to private clinics. It is a versatile solution for the initial diagnosis, follow-up screening, and severity assessment of a wide range of respiratory diseases. The system is essential for the differential diagnosis of obstructive conditions—such as Asthma, COPD, and Emphysema—as well as restrictive diseases, including Interstitial Lung Disease, pulmonary fibrosis, and neuromuscular disorders. Enhanced Safety and Versatility Designed with modern clinical needs in mind, the Spirostik Blue offers unparalleled flexibility. It can be used as a standalone spirometer or networked across multiple locations to centralise patient results from a group of practices. To ensure the highest standards of hygiene, the system utilises pre-calibrated, single-use flow sensors with extremely low dead space, significantly improving patient safety while eliminating the need for manual calibration.

The Ambistik is a high-precision, USB-based module designed to monitor environmental conditions temperature, barometric pressure, and humidity with total accuracy. This data is continuously fed into the BLUE CHERRY® software suite, enabling the system to perform real-time BTPS (Body Temperature, Pressure, and Saturated) corrections. Why Environmental Accuracy Matters In pulmonary function testing, precision is paramount. Lung function is measured at a constant body temperature of 37°C. As exhaled air cools, its volume decreases; even a small temperature variance of 2°C can result in a 1% deviation in measured results. Furthermore, atmospheric pressure—which fluctuates significantly between sea level and high altitudes—and humidity levels directly impact gas volume and oxygen concentration. Without accurate, real-time correction for these variables, diagnostic data can be compromised. The Ambistik eliminates this risk by providing a continuous stream of ambient data, ensuring every measurement is standardised and clinically valid.

The transition from recorder to report is seamless: the system features simplified device preparation and automatic patient assignment upon data import, significantly reducing the administrative burden on clinical staff. detail.description: The ergoscan system represents a sophisticated approach to ambulatory blood pressure monitoring, combining advanced oscillometric technology with durable, clinician-focused design. Engineered for high-traffic medical environments, the ergoscan ensures the acquisition of clean, reliable data while prioritising ease of use for both the patient and the healthcare provider. Precision Technology and Artefact Suppression At the core of the ergoscan is a specialised oscillometric measuring logic that eliminates the need for cumbersome microphones or electrodes. This technology is specifically designed to suppress motion artefacts, ensuring that readings remain accurate even during the patient’s daily activities. The result is a more comfortable patient experience and a significantly more reliable diagnostic dataset for the clinician. Intelligent Workflow and Data Integrity The ergoscan is built for the rigours of daily clinical practice. It features a robust, snap-on metal cuff connector that ensures a secure, leak-proof attachment between the cuff and the recorder. To further enhance data accuracy, the device includes a dedicated day/night button. This allows the patient to manually signal their actual sleep transitions, enabling the software to precisely evaluate diurnally important differences without the need for manual, time-consuming corrections after the test.

The AMEDTEC Holter-RR is a premier solution for 24-hour ambulatory blood pressure monitoring (ABPM), designed to deliver highly accurate, meaningful data in a patient-friendly format. Validated to the most stringent international standards, this system provides clinicians with a reliable foundation for the diagnosis and management of hypertension and related cardiovascular conditions. Intelligent Comfort and Clinical Versatility Patient compliance is critical to successful ambulatory monitoring. The Holter-RR utilises Auto Feedback Logic (AFL), an advanced inflation algorithm that ensures quiet, rapid measurements with significantly lower cuff pressure. This adaptive approach, combined with the ability to record for up to 72 hours, makes it an ideal tool for long-term clinical assessment. Furthermore, the system includes integrated threshold tables for children and adolescents, ensuring precise and age-appropriate interpretation across all patient demographics. DDC Stainless Steel Furniture Stainless steel furniture is the hallmark of pristine surgical suites, and has raised the bar for what we expect to see in a safe, sanitary and sterile medical environment. But surgical settings are not the only places which need to be kept sterile for patient safety – preventing the spread of dangerous pathogens in potentially unclean environments such as your sluice or dirty utility room is just as vital to the success of any infection control strategy. By equipping your sluice room with stainless steel fixtures and fittings, you can take care of infection control from the ground up. All surfaces in a sluice room must be able to be thoroughly cleaned; or they could harbour bacteria and become the breeding ground for dangerous pathogens. The smooth surfaces and clean welds on stainless steel furniture mean that microbes can find very few places to hide; there are seldom any crevices where germs can become trapped and difficult to remove. Similarly, stainless steel is corrosion-resistant, allowing for strong cleaning agents to be used without risking degrading the metal. detail.description: Footbox Chunc footboxes are designed to support safe, consistent foot positioning within a wheelchair seating system. By maintaining correct foot alignment, they help reduce strain on joints and muscles while supporting a neutral pelvic position — a key foundation for stable and effective seated posture. A footbox is particularly beneficial for users with increased muscle tone, involuntary movements, contractures, or reduced sensation in the lower limbs. By enclosing the feet, it helps prevent them from slipping off the footplates, protects against accidental impacts or friction, and assists in managing uncontrolled leg or foot movements. This added containment supports improved lower limb stability and overall postural control. Optional padding can be added to enhance comfort and pressure management. Padded footboxes help distribute pressure more evenly, reduce muscle fatigue by minimising the effort required to maintain positioning, and lower the risk of pressure-related skin concerns during prolonged use. Footboxes are often considered for users who spend long periods in their wheelchair, have a higher risk of pressure injury, experience spasms or high muscle tone, or require additional postural support for development. They can also provide reassurance for caregivers by helping maintain consistent and protected foot positioning throughout daily activities. Flip-up footbox options are available for users who require greater flexibility. These designs allow easier access for transfers, support foot positioning prior to standing, and enable leg position adjustments throughout the day. This makes them particularly helpful when caregiver access and functional movement are important considerations.

Sunshade and Raincover Designed specifically for Chunc wheelchairs, the sunshade and raincover offers versatile protection for children and adults in any weather. Whether shielding from harsh sunlight or keeping dry in rain, this accessory ensures comfort, safety, and continued participation in outdoor activities. The lightweight, durable design is easy to attach and remove, and its adjustable frame allows a secure fit for different wheelchair models. Transparent panels maintain visibility, while side and rear coverage help protect from wind and rain. Perfect for parents and caregivers, the Chunc sunshade and rain cover enhances user comfort during outdoor activities, excursions, and daily travel. Its practical, easy to use design makes it an essential functional accessory for Chunc wheelchair users.

Under Chassis Equipment Tray For wheelchair users with complex medical and mobility needs, essential life-support equipment must remain safely secured, easily accessible, and stable throughout the day. Under-chassis equipment trays provide a practical and reliable solution by creating dedicated, low-profile storage space beneath the wheelchair frame. These trays are designed to support a wide range of critical equipment, including oxygen cylinders, suction machines, portable ventilators, battery packs, and other medical devices that may need to be used continuously. By keeping equipment securely positioned under the chassis, they help maintain a clean, organised seating environment without compromising comfort or mobility. Under-chassis trays are designed around real-world care requirements, supporting frequent transfers in and out of the wheelchair, carer-led adjustments, indoor and outdoor use, and transport in accessible vehicles. Their integrated design helps ensure equipment remains stable and accessible while supporting long-duration comfort and consistent seating performance. Specifically, under-chassis trays provide a secure sub-frame storage platform that helps keep weight low for improved wheelchair stability. They also protect equipment from accidental knocks and damage, free up rear and side space for carers and additional accessories, and support continuous use without interfering with postural setup or seating alignment. By combining safety, practicality, and accessibility, under-chassis equipment trays help make daily care more manageable for both users and carers while supporting complex mobility and medical requirements.

Oxygen Cylinder Mounts This oxygen cylinder mount has been carefully designed to provide a stable and secure method of holding oxygen cylinders during routine, day-to-day use. Built with durability and reliability in mind, the system reflects a strong focus on quality materials and sound engineering principles, giving clinicians and families confidence in its performance within a static care environment. The mount integrates seamlessly with the Chunc chair range, while its adaptable design means it may also be suitable for use with other wheelchair models. This flexibility allows it to meet a wide range of user needs without compromising on stability or ease of use. Its straightforward attachment and secure hold make it an essential accessory for individuals who require consistent access to oxygen therapy, supporting both independence and comfort. While the system has not been formally crash tested or validated for use in moving vehicles, its design ensures that, when properly installed, the cylinder remains well-supported during normal use. For situations involving transport, it is important that a separate, user-led risk assessment is carried out. Factors such as wheelchair configuration, vehicle type, and additional accessories can all influence safety, and appropriate precautions should always be taken to ensure the cylinder is correctly positioned and fully restrained. Overall, this mount offers a dependable, high-quality solution for safely carrying oxygen in everyday settings—supporting users, families, and clinicians with a practical and adaptable piece of equipment. For a full-time wheelchair user.

Communication Aid Mounting Brackets For communication aids to be truly effective, correct and consistent positioning is essential. Mounting the device to the wheelchair is therefore just as important as the technology itself, ensuring the user can access it reliably throughout the day. Chunc’s communication aid bracket provides a secure and stable mounting solution, keeping the device within the user’s optimal line of sight and reachable range at all times. This supports more immediate access to communication, reducing the need for caregiver assistance with setup or repositioning and enabling greater independence, faster interaction, and more natural conversation. The bracket assembly is height adjustable to accommodate individual postural requirements and user needs, supporting optimal positioning across a range of seating setups. Designed for versatility, it is compatible with a wide variety of communication aids and integrates seamlessly with Chunc wheelchair systems. This solution helps ensure that communication remains consistently accessible, supporting participation, expression, and engagement in daily life. Please note: This product includes the bracket assembly only. Communication devices are not included.

Activity Tray An activity tray is more than a surface for tasks — it acts as a postural, functional, and assistive support system within a wheelchair seating setup. By providing a stable, accessible platform, it helps promote improved posture, upper limb control, and functional independence during a wide range of daily activities. The tray offers secure forearm and hand positioning, supporting comfort and stability for tasks such as eating, writing, using communication aids, and engaging in sensory or educational activities. This helps users maintain a more functional upper body position while carrying out everyday tasks. Designed with practicality in mind, the tray features a durable, easy-clean surface with raised edges to help prevent items from slipping or falling. It can be securely fitted to all Chunc wheelchairs and is designed for quick and easy removal, supporting safe and efficient transfers when required. The activity tray also helps create a structured, contained working area, allowing users to focus visually and physically on the activity in front of them. Essential items such as plates, books, or devices can be positioned within easy reach, supporting consistency and predictability in daily routines. By combining postural support with functional usability, the activity tray enhances independence, safety, and meaningful engagement in everyday activities.

Recline Kit (180°) This configuration provides the highest level of clinical flexibility, combining tilt-in-space with full recline to 180°, enabling transition from seated to a fully supine position. It supports full pressure redistribution and offers enhanced capability for managing complex needs, including high tone and spasticity. The ability to reposition fully within the chair can assist with hygiene care, unplanned events, and situations where reducing transfers is beneficial for both the user and carers. Tilt-in-space continues to provide effective pressure management and postural stability during seated phases, while full recline enables complete body repositioning when required. An important clinical consideration is that postural supports must be readjusted when moving into supine and again when returning to an upright position, as alignment changes significantly through these transitions. Tilt-in-space at 45° underpins postural stability and pressure management, with recline extending capability to full supine positioning—introducing additional clinical considerations that must be managed as part of a complete seating system. Selection of the appropriate configuration should always be guided by an Occupational Therapist or specialist seating assessment to ensure safe and effective clinical outcomes.

Recline Kit (160°) Combining pressure care through tilt-in-space with functional repositioning via recline, this configuration delivers a highly effective and stable seating solution. Recline 160 opens the back angle up to 160°, allowing the user to move into a semi-supine position while keeping all postural supports in place. The backrest moves backwards while the seat remains fixed, opening the hip angle and enabling the user to “lean back” without compromising their established positioning. This differs from tilt-in-space, where the entire seating system tilts as one unit, maintaining all body angles. When used together, tilt and recline provide complementary benefits—tilt supports pressure redistribution and minimises shear, while recline enables controlled changes in posture and hip angle. Reclining helps redistribute pressure away from the pelvis and sitting bones and can support users who experience fatigue in upright sitting. It allows the body to settle where independent postural control is limited, offering rest periods without the need for transfers. This can reduce physical demand on carers and improve tolerance for extended periods of use, including community participation. Tilt-in-space at 45° underpins postural stability and pressure management, with recline adding controlled hip angle adjustment—introducing additional clinical considerations such as shear, which must be managed as part of a complete seating system. Selection of the appropriate configuration should always be guided by an Occupational Therapist or specialist seating assessment to ensure safe and effective clinical outcomes.

Elbow Blockers Chunc elbow blockers are designed to improve upper limb positioning, providing supportive guidance for the arms and elbows to enhance comfort, control, and overall sitting stability. Particularly beneficial for users with reduced muscle control, they help maintain consistent arm placement on the armrests, preventing the arms from slipping off the side or falling behind the seat. By supporting the upper limbs, elbow blockers contribute to improved overall postural alignment and can help reduce slumping during seated activities. This added stability supports a more balanced upper body position, which in turn can enhance functional comfort throughout the day. Elbow blockers also help reduce fatigue by minimising strain on the shoulder and upper back muscles during prolonged sitting. In addition, they help prevent accidental arm movement that could lead to discomfort or injury, particularly during wheelchair movement, transfers, or changes in position. This ensures the arms remain safely positioned and clearly supported at all times. Chunc elbow blockers are available in left and right-handed options, as well as small and large sizes, allowing for tailored positioning to suit individual user needs and seating configurations.

Height Adjustable Arm Support (Pair) Standard or Multiplane Adjustable arm supports provide consistent and reliable forearm support, helping clinicians fine-tune upper limb positioning to improve posture, stability, and comfort throughout the day. With flexible mounting and adjustable positioning, the system supports a wide range of clinical needs and functional goals. Both options help to: Promote midline orientation Reduce compensatory trunk movements Support a more stable and energy-efficient sitting posture Reduce load through the shoulders Improve overall trunk alignment Provide a stable base for functional activities Front or rear mounting options allow the setup to be tailored for both clinical positioning and practical considerations, including safe transfers in and out of the wheelchair. Option 1: Height Adjustable Arm Supports Height adjustable arm supports provide reliable forearm support for users who benefit from improved upper limb positioning but do not require additional containment. Adjustable height and flexible mounting allow precise alignment, helping maintain a supported and symmetrical sitting posture. This option is ideal for: Reduced trunk control Postural asymmetry Fatigue from unsupported arms Functional activity support Option 2: Multiplane Adjustable Arm Supports with Elbow Containment The multiplane adjustable arm supports with elbow containment provide a higher level of positioning and stability for users with limited or no voluntary arm control. Multi-axis adjustability — including height, angle, width, and mounting position — allows highly individualised setup. Integrated elbow containment offers gentle guidance to: Help prevent shoulder subluxation Reduce uncontrolled or involuntary arm movement Support consistent midline orientation Improve overall postural integrity Reduce asymmetrical loading This option is particularly beneficial where muscle tone fluctuates, arm control is limited, or unsupported movement impacts posture or safe

detail.description: Toe Straps Featuring a convenient hook-and-loop fastening system, these straps allow for quick, adjustable, and hassle-free application and removal, ensuring a secure yet comfortable fit. Made from durable nylon fabric, they provide long-lasting performance while maintaining user comfort throughout the day. Sold in pairs: 58cm strap length

Ankle Huggers Chunc Ankle Huggers are anatomically contoured to surround the ankle, providing lateral stability while evenly distributing pressure for improved comfort and skin protection. Ankle huggers aid foot positioning and act as an alternative to foot straps. Stabilising the foot and ankle helps improve balance and supports better posture when sitting or moving. Their dynamic, flexible design offers a more comfortable and effective alternative to traditional rigid foot straps. Sold in pairs.

Shoulder Harnessing Chest harnesses are designed to provide additional upper body positioning within a wheelchair seating system. Used as a secondary postural support, they help improve trunk and upper thoracic alignment by offering gentle anterior and posterior stability. This makes them particularly beneficial when pelvic positioning and lateral supports alone are not enough to maintain functional sitting posture. Harnessing should always complement, not replace, a well-configured seating setup. Accurate measurement and correct fitting are essential to achieve effective support, even pressure distribution, and long-term comfort. When properly positioned, the harness should sit securely across the chest without shifting during use, supporting stability while allowing functional movement. A range of harness styles is available to suit different clinical needs. Cross-shoulder harnesses are typically used for higher levels of postural instability, asymmetry, or reduced trunk control. They help promote midline thoracic alignment and reduce asymmetrical collapse, making them suitable for users with significant instability, complex tone patterns, or poor head and trunk dissociation. Narrow front-pull harnesses are suited to users requiring lighter support. These designs offer greater upper limb freedom while helping to resist forward flexion. They are often appropriate for mild to moderate instability or when reminder-style support is sufficient to maintain positioning. Regular review is recommended to ensure the harness continues to provide effective support as needs change. Monitoring fit and positioning helps maintain comfort, minimise the risk of pressure, and ensure the user receives appropriate postural support within their overall seating system.

Lap Belt Designed to help maintain a stable and safe pelvic position in a seated posture. Secured across the pelvis (hips), anchoring chair user into the seat. It is positioned across the bony pelvis and adjusted to provide secure but non-restrictive support. A 2-point system is typically used as the baseline option. Preventing forward sliding in the seat, maintaining general pelvic stability. Supports a neutral seated posture in users with: Good or moderate trunk control Predictable sitting balance Low to moderate postural asymmetry A 4-point system provides additional directional control of the pelvis, using two anterior and two posterior/anchoring points. Best for complex or unstable sitting postures: Actively controls pelvic alignment in multiple planes Help correct or manage asymmetry Reduces pelvic rotation and uneven loading If you would like support identifying the most appropriate option for an individual, or need help reviewing an existing seating setup, please get in touch.

detail.description: Footplates Chunc footplates provide essential lower limb support, creating a stable base that helps promote balanced weight distribution and improved seated posture. Without appropriate foot support, a greater proportion of body weight is transferred to the thighs and ischial tuberosities, increasing the risk of discomfort and pressure-related concerns. Properly adjusted footplates help redistribute load more evenly, reducing pressure on the buttocks and rear thighs during prolonged sitting. In addition to pressure management, footplates play an important role in overall postural stability. By maintaining consistent foot positioning, they help support correct pelvic alignment, which forms the foundation for trunk stability and spinal positioning. This can reduce the likelihood of slouching, forward sliding, and asymmetrical sitting. Footplates also improve safety by preventing the feet from dragging, striking objects, or becoming caught in wheelchair components such as caster wheels. This helps support safer mobility both indoors and outdoors. For optimal positioning, footplates should typically be adjusted to achieve approximately 90° at the hips, knees, and ankles, supporting a neutral and balanced seated posture. Swing-away or elevating options can improve access for transfers, allowing the user to position closer to beds, chairs, or toilets while supporting safer transitions. Chunc footplates are available in a range of configurations, including fixed full-width platforms for consistent support, and independent (split) footplates for users requiring individual leg positioning and adjustability.

Calf Pads Chunc calf pads are designed to enhance lower limb stability, comfort, and safety for wheelchair users. They help maintain correct leg positioning during movement and seating adjustments, including when the seat is tilted or the leg rests are elevated. By supporting the calves, they reduce strain on heel straps and help promote more even pressure distribution across the lower limbs. In addition to improving comfort, calf pads play an important safety role by helping to prevent the feet from slipping off the footrests or becoming caught in wheelchair components. This reduces the risk of injury and supports more secure, confident positioning throughout the day. Calf pads provide both postural support and safety benefits, contributing to improved overall seating stability. For best results, they should be used alongside other foot positioning accessories such as heel loops and footplate padding to ensure balanced support and optimal pressure management.

Seat Cushions The range at a glance: Standard shaped – everyday comfort and protection without correction Contour – guided positioning with improved stability Ischial – focused protection of key pressure points with pelvic stability Enhanced contour – advanced postural support for more complex needs From comfort and protection without correction through to guided positioning with improved stability, and focused protection of key pressure points with pelvic support. Simply use the selector tool to find the most appropriate level of support. An assessment is recommended where there are concerns around prolonged sitting, reduced mobility, or changing postural needs. Preventing pressure ulcers is a key benefit, particularly for people with spinal cord injury, stroke, or reduced sensation. Improving posture and body alignment, appropriate seating can help address issues such as pelvic obliquity, forward sliding, and postural asymmetry, supporting a more balanced sitting position. Enhancing comfort and tolerance of sitting allows longer, more comfortable periods of use, helping support participation in daily activities and reducing the risk of secondary complications associated with poor sitting posture or prolonged pressure.

detail.description: Pommel The Chunc pommel is a clinical positioning aid. Its purpose is to improve lower-limb alignment, enhance postural stability, and support safe, comfortable seated function. It is particularly beneficial for individuals who require assistance maintaining leg alignment and preventing unwanted forward or lateral movement while seated. Positioned between the legs, the pommel helps guide and stabilise the user’s posture, supporting a more secure and functional seating position. This can improve overall comfort, reduce the risk of sliding, and enhance stability during everyday activities. The pommel is available in both fixed and adjustable options, allowing clinicians and caregivers to select the most appropriate setup for each user’s needs. Its padded design ensures comfort during prolonged use, while its durable construction supports consistent performance in daily environments. Designed for seamless compatibility with the Chunc wheelchair range, the pommel integrates easily into existing seating systems, providing a practical and effective solution for improved positioning and support.

Supportive Back Cushion The custom contoured wheelchair back supports provide enhanced postural control straight away. Its shape is designed to closely match the user’s body rather than relying on flat or generic surfaces. This can reduce fatigue, improve sitting tolerance, and enhance functional performance such as head control and upper limb freedom.
